childId.description: The pstack child id returned by pstack_subagent.

provider.description: A registered provider id or display name; omit for every provider.

childId.description: The pstack child id returned by pstack_subagent.

message.description: The follow-up message to deliver to that child.

name.description: Exact kebab-case skill name, such as `how` or `principle-prove-it-works`.

resource.description: Optional path relative to the skill directory.

description.description: Optional short 3-5 word label for the child; derived from the prompt when omitted.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained brief. The child does not see this conversation.

agent.description: Optional child preset; defaults to "general". "poteto-agent" for pstack implementation, "comment-sicko" for comment review, "readonly" for a sandbox-enforced read-only researcher.

provider.description: Optional model provider; pass together with `model` to override the child route, or omit both to inherit the parent route.

model.description: Optional model id; pass together with `provider` to override the child route, or omit both to inherit the parent route.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional advertised reasoning-effort token; omit to keep the route's default effort.

cwd.description: Optional initial child working directory; omit to inherit the session directory.

maxDepth.description: Optional delegation-depth cap. Omit or null to use the configured row and Host cap; explicit values must be at least 1 and cannot exceed that cap.
